name: prone
hint: lying down: z to get up
description: Lying down: awful for melee, fine for shooting, and a smaller target at range.

name: stunned
hint: reeling: can't act for a moment

name: in agony
hint: doubled over: can't act for a moment

name: in the air
description: Flying through the air (see flight.py): nothing to do until you land.

name: given up
description: Down, hurt and done: not fighting any more, and nobody's bothering with them. Patches themselves up if they can.

name: collapsed
hint: legs gave out (pain): can't stand yet, -2
description: The pain (or exhaustion) has taken your legs. Still awake: you can crawl, shoot and fight, badly, from the floor. A WIS roll every 10 s to get your feet under you again.

name: heart stopped
description: No circulation. Seconds of consciousness left, then brain death within minutes.

name: held
hint: someone has hold of you: move to struggle

name: on fire
description: Burning clothes: 1d burn a second until it goes out. Going prone may smother it.

name: broken neck
description: Spinal cord severed high up: paralysed and not breathing. Brain death in a few minutes.

name: crushed windpipe
description: The airway is crushed shut. Unconscious in moments, dead in under two minutes without a tracheotomy.

name: startled
description: Grabbed out of nowhere: a moment before you can do anything about it.

name: punctured lung
description: Blood and air in the chest: you can't get your breath back past 60%, and the lung bleeds inside.

name: both lungs punctured
description: Neither lung works: every breath is blood. Unconscious in under a minute, dead a few minutes later.

name: spine severed
description: The spinal cord is cut: the legs are dead weight. You can still use your arms, and drag yourself along.
